nodes.label: Repository agent guidance
nodes.content: Repository guidance describes recursive flake architecture, named module leaves, hosts, package consumers, secrets, and validation commands.

nodes.label: Flake validation workflow
nodes.content: Validation includes alejandra formatting, nix flake check with path:. and show-trace, host closure builds, and optional statix linting.

nodes.label: Supported NixOS hosts
nodes.content: The flake defines aku, gru, lich, and tai-lung hosts using the explicit configuration/hardware composition pattern.

edges.evidence: Repository guidance says README.md is authoritative for adding features, packages, and hosts.
The architecture section names aku, gru, lich, and tai-lung.
The validation section lists alejandra, nix flake check, nix build, and statix.
The named hosts use separate configuration and hardware modules composed through host defaults.
